stem:
Chetan sorts four closed shapes drawn for class: a rectangle; a circle; a triangle; and a six-sided polygon with straight sides.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims correctly decide which shape is a quadrilateral?

options.text: The rectangle is a quadrilateral because it has four straight sides.
The circle is a quadrilateral because it is a closed shape.
A quadrilateral must have exactly four straight sides, so the rectangle qualifies and the circle does not.
The six-sided polygon is a quadrilateral because its sides are straight.

teacher.key_rationale: A quadrilateral is a four-sided straight-sided closed shape. Only the rectangle meets that. Being closed or having straight sides with the wrong side count is not enough.
